title: 第23章 敲诈第24章 成为肥肉的石溪领
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
第二天上午，石溪岭的使者到了。
罗恩认得他，就是那天被怼得腿软的那个。今天他脸色还是发白，但腰弯得更低，站在罗恩面前时，连头都不敢抬。
“罗、罗恩男爵，我家大人让我来传话。”
罗恩坐在椅子上，手里拿着块面包，没抬头：
“说！”
使者咽了口唾沫：“我家大人说，他确实没看见您丢的那两只精灵虫。”
“不过愿意给您一千农奴，条件是您要以家族的名义保证，以后不再骚扰石溪领。”
罗恩咬面包的动作顿了一下。
他抬起头，看着使者。
“一千农奴？”
使者点头：“是，一千。”
罗恩把面包放下，擦了擦手，靠在椅背上。
“彼得老爷就给我一千农奴，换我保证不再骚扰？”他笑了一声。
“他在这打发要饭的呢？”
“我是要饭的嘛？你告诉我。”
使者脸色一白，不敢接话。
罗恩站起身，走到他面前。
“你回去告诉他，”他的声音不大，但每个字都清楚.
“一千农奴不够。我要两千。”
使者愣了：“两、两千？”

“两千。”罗恩看着他。
“农奴两千，粮食五万斤，农具三百套。少一样，免谈。”
使者急了：“大人，这、这也太多了……”
罗恩摆摆手：“多不多不是你说了算。回去告诉彼得那狗东西，他那个破庄园里窝着四五千农奴”
“给我两千怎么了？又不是要他的命。”
“他要是同意，我马上就以家族名义担保，愿意和石溪领恢复友好关系。他要是不同意，那他领地里的马匪就不要来找我，让他去找他爹去吧。”
使者愣住了。
罗恩拍拍他肩膀：
“我这个人好说话，别人给我面子，我也给别人面子。但你家大人要是只给一千农奴就想打发我，那我也只好让他看看，什么叫做‘不骚扰’。”
使者张了张嘴，说不出话。
罗恩转身往回走，丢下一句：“明天这时候，我等你回信。”
content_en:
The next morning, the messenger from Shixiling arrived.
Ron recognized him, he was the one who was beaten to the point of weakness that day. Today, his face was still pale, but he stooped lower and did not even dare to raise his head when standing in front of Ron.
"Lo, Baron Ron, my master asked me to deliver a message."
Ron sat on a chair, holding a piece of bread in his hand, without looking up:
"Say!"
The messenger swallowed: "My master said that he indeed did not see the two elf bugs you threw away."
"But I am willing to give you one thousand serfs, on the condition that you promise in the name of your family that you will not harass the Stone Creek Territory again."
Ron paused while biting the bread.
He raised his head and looked at the messenger.
"A thousand serfs?"
The messenger nodded: "Yes, one thousand."
Ron put the bread down, wiped his hands, and leaned back in his chair.
"Master Peter will give me a thousand serfs in exchange for my promise not to harass you again?" He laughed.
"Where is he sending the beggars here?"
"Am I begging for food? Tell me."
The messenger turned pale and did not dare to answer.
Ron stood up and walked over to him.
"You go back and tell him," his voice was not loud, but every word was clear.
"A thousand serfs are not enough. I want two thousand."
The messenger was stunned: "Two, two thousand?"
"Two thousand." Ron looked at him.
"Two thousand serfs, fifty thousand catties of grain, and three hundred sets of farm tools. If there are less than one thing, there is no need to discuss it."
The messenger became anxious: "Sir, this, this is too much..."
Ron waved his hand: "It's not up to you to decide whether it's more or less. Go back and tell that bitch Peter that there are four to five thousand serfs in his shabby manor."
"What's wrong with giving me two thousand? It's not like you want to kill him."
"If he agrees, I will immediately guarantee in the name of my family that I am willing to restore friendly relations with the Stone Brook Territory. If he does not agree, then the horse bandits in his territory should not come to me, and let him go to his father."
The messenger was stunned.
Ron patted him on the shoulder:
"I am easy to talk to. If others give me face, I will give others face. But if your master wants to send me away after only giving you a thousand serfs, then I have to show him what 'no harassment' means."
The messenger opened his mouth but could not speak.
Ron turned around and walked back, saying, "I'll wait for your reply at this time tomorrow."
